articles.title: For What Reason? Interpreting Models' Encoding of Causation and Antithesis
articles.abstract: Discourse relations provide document structure, critical to language understanding and enabling language model performance and ethicality. In this work, we investigate how instruction-tuned Transformer models (LLaMA and Mistral) encode discourse relations in English, with a particular focus on the contrasting relations of causation and antithesis. Framing the task as a next-token prediction task and applying a suite of interpretability techniques to test model internals, our findings show that certain early layers make predictive decisions at mid-sequence tokens, while some mid-level layers finalize their decisions closer to the last token. Most of the remaining layers primarily propagate earlier decisions rather than actively influencing them. Additionally, we observe that some layers exhibit a preference for one answer over alternatives, suggesting asymmetric representation of discourse-based reasoning.\footnote{Our code is available at https://github.com/abhidipbhattacharyya/causation_vs_antithesis}
articles.titleCn: 为何如此？解读模型对因果关系与对立的编码
articles.abstractCn: 话语关系为文档结构提供支撑，对语言理解至关重要，并影响语言模型的性能与伦理。在本工作中，我们研究了指令微调的Transformer模型（LLaMA和Mistral）如何编码英语中的话语关系，特别关注因果关系与对立关系之间的对比。我们将任务定义为下一词预测任务，并应用一系列可解释性技术来测试模型内部机制，研究发现某些早期层在序列中部位置做出预测性决策，而一些中层则在接近最后一个词时最终确定其决策。其余大部分层主要传播早期决策而非主动影响决策。此外，我们观察到某些层对某个答案有偏好，超过其他选项，这表明基于话语的推理存在非对称表征。

articles.title: The Story Shapes the Agent: Narrative Priors in LLM Behavior
articles.abstract: Persona prompting is widely used to steer LLM agent behavior, yet the narrative framing of a task can matter more than the assigned persona. We isolate this effect through structural isomorphism, constructing three text-based investigation games that share the same action space, stage progression, and resource constraints while varying only task narrative: disease investigation, IT troubleshooting, and murder mystery. Across 1,890 sessions spanning 3 models and 10 personas, we identify narrative priors: systematic action tendencies activated by a task's story framing, independent of its decision structure. Narrative priors explain 5-31x more behavioral variance than persona, are consistent across model architectures, and in two of three domains are negatively associated with task success. Persona effects that do transfer across narratives arise from behavioral anchors, persona descriptions whose language maps directly onto shared actions. Causal interventions confirm this: removing anchor words from a high-transfer persona reduces cross-narrative consistency by 95%. Our framework also generalizes to a held-out fourth narrative and yields a persona-selection method that improves cross-narrative transfer. These results suggest that LLM behavior that survives narrative changes should be grounded in concrete actions rather than abstract descriptions.

articles.titleCn: 故事塑造智能体：大型语言模型的行为中的叙事先验
articles.abstractCn: 角色提示被广泛用于引导大语言模型代理的行为，但任务的故事框架可能比分配的角色更重要。我们通过结构同构来分离这种效应，构建了三个基于文本的调查游戏，它们共享相同的动作空间、阶段进程和资源限制，仅改变任务叙事：疾病调查、IT故障排除和谋杀之谜。在涵盖3个模型和10个角色的1890个会话中，我们识别出叙事先验：由任务的故事框架激活的系统性行动倾向，独立于其决策结构。叙事先验解释了比角色多5-31倍的的行为差异，在不同模型架构中保持一致，并且在三个领域中的两个与任务成功率呈负相关。那些确实会跨叙事转移的角色效应源于行为锚点，即角色描述中直接映射到共享动作的语言。因果干预证实了这一点：从具有高转移性的角色描述中移除锚点词，将跨叙事一致性降低了95%。我们的框架也适用于一个保留的第四个叙事，并产生了一种改进跨叙事转移的角色选择方法。这些结果表明，能够经受叙事变化的LLM行为应该基于具体行动而非抽象描述。

articles.title: Reasoning Fine-Tuning Induces Persistent Latent Policy States
articles.abstract: Reasoning-specialized language models show large performance gains over base models, yet the internal changes responsible for improved multi-step reasoning remain poorly understood. It is unclear whether reasoning fine-tuning improves local token-level competence or globally reorganizes how models structure inference over time. We address this question by modeling Chain-of-Thought reasoning as a switching dynamical system (SDS), in which internal representations evolve under discrete latent policy states. Our framework combines time-aware contrastive representation learning with discrete regime discovery to recover latent policies from activation trajectories. Across four benchmarks and model scales from 1.5B to 32B parameters, reasoning-fine-tuned models exhibit richer latent-policy organization than their base counterparts, characterized by more differentiated transition structure and model-dependent changes in state utilization, persistence, and mixing. The recovered regimes exhibit functional specialization aligned with distinct reasoning stages, and extensive controls confirm that their structure is not explained by correctness, representation learning, or modeling priors, but depends on the coherent temporal organization of reasoning trajectories. Causal interventions further show that the regimes are functionally meaningful: state-swap ablations reduce one-step predictive fit, while transplanting reasoning dynamics into base models improves performance on challenging reasoning problems. Finally, SDS-guided pruning of failure-prone reasoning prefixes outperforms self-consistency in 11 of 12 model-dataset settings, with gains of up to 12.5 percentage points. Together, our results suggest that reasoning fine-tuning globally reorganizes latent dynamics, offering a new lens for mechanistic analysis and process-level control of reasoning models.

articles.titleCn: 推理微调会诱导持续的潜在策略状态
articles.abstractCn: 推理专用语言模型相较于基础模型表现出显著的性能提升，然而负责改进多步推理的内部变化仍不明确。尚不清楚推理微调是提升了模型的局部token级能力，还是全局重组了模型随时间进行推理的结构。我们通过将思维链推理建模为切换动力系统（SDS），其中内部表征在离散潜态策略下演化，来解答这一问题。我们的框架结合了时间感知对比表征学习与离散状态发现，从激活轨迹中恢复潜态策略。在四个基准测试和1.5B到32B参数规模的模型中，推理微调后的模型展现出比基础模型更丰富的潜态策略组织，其特征为更细化的转换结构和模型依赖的状态利用、持久性及混合变化。恢复的状态表现出与不同推理阶段相一致的功能专业化，广泛的控制实验证实其结构并非由正确性、表征学习或建模先验解释，而是依赖于推理轨迹的连贯时间组织。因果干预进一步表明这些状态具有功能性意义：状态交换消融会降低单步预测拟合度，而将推理动态移植到基础模型则提升了在挑战性推理问题上的性能。最后，SDS引导的易出错推理前缀剪枝在12个模型-数据集设置中的11个中优于自洽性，增益最高达12.5个百分点。综合来看，我们的结果表明推理微调全局重组了潜态动态，为推理模型的机制分析和过程级控制提供了新视角。

articles.title: Search-on-Graph-R1: Training Large Language Models to Search Knowledge Graphs with Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires navigating from topic entities to an answer several relations away. Recent methods prompt a frontier LLM to explore the graph through a retrieval tool, but their reliance on frontier-scale inference makes them costly to deploy. We present Search-on-Graph-R1 (\sogrone{}), which internalizes this navigation into a compact 8B model through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL). Our central idea is to scaffold a frontier teacher with each question's gold SPARQL query, so the teacher traverses a known answer-bearing path with a live \texttt{Search} tool rather than having to discover the path itself. Since every call executes against a live Freebase server, the resulting trajectories are grounded in the knowledge graph by construction. On WebQSP, CWQ, and GrailQA, \sogrone{} at 8B surpasses every frozen frontier-LLM system in our comparison and posts the strongest results on CWQ of any system we compare against. It does so using no auxiliary module at inference and no LLM judge during training. Isolating each training stage shows that SFT and RL contribute complementary gains, our approach transfers across model families, and RL learns to reach answers in fewer \texttt{Search} calls than its SFT initialization.
articles.titleCn: 基于图的搜索R1：使用强化学习训练大型语言模型搜索知识图谱
articles.abstractCn: 知识图谱问答（KGQA）需要在主题实体与相距数个关系的答案之间进行导航。近期方法通过检索工具提示前沿大型语言模型（LLM）探索图谱，但它们对前沿规模推理的依赖导致部署成本高昂。我们提出了基于图谱搜索的R1模型（\sogrone{}），通过监督微调（SFT）随后强化学习（RL）将导航过程内化于一个紧凑的8B模型中。我们的核心思想是利用每个问题的黄金SPARQL查询为前沿教师搭建框架，使教师通过实时\texttt{Search}工具遍历已知包含答案的路径，而非自行发现路径。由于每次调用都针对实时Freebase服务器执行，生成的轨迹在构造上就与知识图谱紧密关联。在WebQSP、CWQ和GrailQA上，\sogrone{}在8B规模上超越了所有冻结的前沿LLM系统，并在CWQ上取得了我们对比系统中最好的结果。它在不使用推理辅助模块和训练期间不使用LLM判别器的情况下实现这一目标。将每个训练阶段单独分析表明，SFT和RL贡献了互补的增益，我们的方法能够跨模型家族迁移，并且RL学习到比SFT初始化时更少的\texttt{Search}调用即可达到答案。

articles.title: Structured Output Collapses Answer Diversity Across 44 Language Models
articles.abstract: When a language model must choose one answer from a large space of equally valid options, a format clause -- "Reply with JSON only" -- changes which answer it chooses. We re-run the One-Word Census (arXiv:2607.12796): 31 wide-answer-space category prompts asked of 44 models, now with the reply requested in JSON -- no schema enforcement, no constrained decoding, only the request. Convergence deepens sharply: on the unconstrained "Pick a word" prompt the modal answer rises from 41% to 64% of the pool and distinct answers fall from 52 to 36; mean answer-choice surprisal drops from 1.80 to 1.58 bits. The tax is progressive: six of 44 models move individually (BH-FDR q=.10), all toward the mode, led by the most distinctive models, while the conformist floor is immobile. It is a sharpener, not a re-indexer -- the plain-chat modal answer survives in 28 of 31 categories. Defaults are register-indexed: a within-run re-sample (n=20) finds JSON shifts 53% of a model's stable chat defaults, mostly back to the crowd, and installs defaults absent from chat (Claude Fable 5 answers "cerulean" for colour 0% of the time in chat, 100% in JSON). Full-battery controls reveal a register gradient: compression is significant and specific to the answer-delivery formats models are trained to speak (JSON -0.22 bits, p=.0002; XML -0.19, p=.002), absent for YAML and CSV, and reversed for an arbitrary bracket wrapper (+0.13, p=.009) -- weighing the mechanism toward tool-use post-training. Enforcing the schema at the decoder (response_format) compresses no further than the request (-0.03 bits): the collapse lives in the model's response to the register, not the decoder. Structured output is how software consumes language models, and that surface is served by a measurably more homogeneous model than the chat surface on which models are evaluated, compared, and chosen.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Companion to the One-Word Census (arXiv:2607.12796). Code, data, and interactive explorer: https://github.com/tap2k/modelun/tree/main/studies/structured
articles.titleCn: 结构化输出导致44种语言模型的答案多样性下降
articles.abstractCn: 当语言模型必须从大量同样有效的选项中选择一个答案时，一个格式条款——"仅以JSON格式回复"——会改变它选择的答案。我们重新运行了一词普查（arXiv:2607.12796）：44个模型被问及了31个宽答案空间类别的提示，现在要求以JSON格式回复——没有模式强制，没有约束解码，只有请求。收敛程度显著加深：在无约束的"选一个词"提示下，众数答案从41%上升到64%的池子，不同答案从52降至36；平均答案选择意外性从1.80降至1.58比特。这种影响是累进的：44个模型中有6个单独移动（BH-FDR q=.10），全部趋向众数，由最具特色的模型引领，而顺从的底线保持不动。这是一种锐化器，而不是重新索引器——在31个类别中的28个，普通聊天的众数答案得以保留。默认值是语域索引的：一次运行内的重采样（n=20）发现JSON使模型稳定的聊天默认值发生了53%的变化，大多回到群体，并安装了聊天中缺失的默认值（Claude Fable 5在聊天中对颜色0%的时间回答"cerulean"，在JSON中为100%）。全电池控制揭示了语域梯度：压缩是显著且特定于模型训练时说话的答案交付格式（JSON -0.22比特，p=.0002；XML -0.19，p=.002），对YAML和CSV无效，并对任意括号包装反转（+0.13，p=.009）——使机制更倾向于训练后的工具使用。在解码器（response_format）处强制模式不会进一步压缩，与请求相比（-0.03比特）：这种崩溃存在于模型对语域的响应中，而不是解码器。结构化输出是软件消费语言模型的方式，而该表面由一个比模型被评估、比较和选择的聊天表面更同质的模型提供。

articles.title: CANDOR: Chance-Calibrated Discordance in Frozen Foundation Encoders
articles.abstract: Frozen encoders are chosen by how well a lightweight head reads a finding from their features, not whether the geometry separates it. Nearest-neighbor discordance does, but with unequal banks the opposite-label neighbor wins on density, not geometry, so prevalence alone makes an uninformed encoder look blind. We introduce CANDOR, a discordance measure whose equal-size banks are symmetric under a label swap, fixing its chance level at exactly one half. Across 22 encoders, 20 datasets from 7 domains, and 605,443 images, this correction reverses the conclusion. Collapse falls below chance almost everywhere, so no encoder is blind, yet all are weak: the best chest model reads pneumothorax at 84.5 AUROC and still places 18.4% of those positives nearer an opposite-label film than its own kind in the same hospital. The same encoder that resolves bird species at 4.5 leaves chest findings at 42.8 and glaucoma at 49.8, at chance and worse than random weights. Such a case caps the normalized margin of any Lipschitz head, yet some head among eleven is correct on all but 2.8% of cases where one head misses 35.9%: the deficit is selection, not information. Erasure retention is associated with collapse; we detect no association with the objective, scale, recency, or size of the finding. Because the chance level is fixed, CANDOR can be read before any head is trained, flagging which findings a frozen encoder supports poorly.
articles.titleCn: 坦诚：冻结基础编码器中的机遇校准不一致性
articles.abstractCn: 冻结编码器是通过轻量级头部读取其特征中的发现来选择的，而不是根据几何形状是否分离它。最近邻不一致性确实如此，但在不等大小的库中，相反标签的邻居在密度上获胜，而不是几何形状，仅所以靠流行度就让未受训练的编码器看起来像盲目。我们引入了CANDOR，一种不一致性度量，其等大小的库在标签交换下是对称的，将其机会水平固定在正好一半。在22个编码器、7个领域的20个数据集和605,443张图像中，这种校正逆转了结论。折叠几乎在所有地方都低于机会水平，所以没有编码器是盲目的，但所有编码器都很弱：最好的胸部模型读取气胸的AUROC为84.5，但仍然将18.4%的这些阳性结果放置在相同医院的相反标签胶片上，而不是自己的类型。同一个编码器在解决鸟类物种分类时达到4.5，但在胸部发现上为42.8，在青光眼上为49.8，处于机会水平且比随机权重更差。这种情况限制了任何Lipschitz头部的标准化边际，但在11个头部中，有一个头部在2.8%的案例中是正确的，而另一个头部在35.9%的案例中出错：这种缺陷是选择问题，而不是信息问题。清除保留与折叠相关；我们没有发现与目标、规模、时效性或发现大小之间的关联。由于机会水平是固定的，CANDOR可以在任何头部训练之前读取，标记冻结编码器支持不佳的发现。

articles.title: PathReportEval: A Systematic Benchmark for Pathology Report Generation
articles.abstract: Pathology report generation from whole-slide images (WSIs) is a rapidly growing multimodal learning problem, yet progress is difficult to measure because existing studies use heterogeneous datasets, model settings, visual encoders, and evaluation protocols. Moreover, commonly used natural language generation metrics, including BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR, primarily reward lexical similarity and often fail to detect clinically consequential errors such as omitted diagnoses, hallucinated findings, or discordant tumor attributes. We present a standardized benchmark and evaluation framework for pathology report generation. The benchmark evaluates four representative methods across three datasets (TCGA, HistAI, and REG 2025) using three pathology foundation encoders (CONCHv1.5, UNI2-h, and H-Optimus-1). Our framework standardizes preprocessing, feature extraction, training, decoding, and evaluation, enabling fair comparison across models while providing a modular platform for integrating new methods, datasets, and encoders. A central contribution is the Clinical Report Quality Score (CRQS), a clinically grounded metric for evaluating factual correctness. CRQS maps reference and generated reports into structured clinical attributes and measures four complementary dimensions: clinical fact coverage, key information recall, hallucination rate, and clinical discordance, producing both an overall score and interpretable sub-scores. Experiments demonstrate that conventional language-generation metrics are weakly aligned with clinical correctness and frequently overestimate report quality. In contrast, CRQS reveals clinically meaningful differences between models and encoders that lexical metrics fail to capture. Together, the benchmark, public plug-and-play framework, and CRQS establish a reproducible foundation for rigorous evaluation of pathology report generation.
articles.titleCn: 病理报告生成系统评估：一个系统性的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 从全切片图像（WSI）生成病理报告是一个快速发展的多模态学习问题，但由于现有研究使用异构数据集、模型设置、视觉编码器和评估协议，因此进展难以衡量。此外，常用的自然语言生成指标，包括BLEU、ROUGE和METEOR，主要奖励词汇相似性，且往往无法检测到临床上有意义的错误，例如遗漏诊断、虚构发现或肿瘤属性的不一致。我们提出了一种用于病理报告生成的标准化基准和评估框架。该基准使用三种病理基础编码器（CONCHv1.5、UNI2-h和H-Optimus-1）在三个数据集（TCGA、HistAI和REG 2025）上评估了四种代表性方法。我们的框架标准化了预处理、特征提取、训练、解码和评估，实现了模型间的公平比较，同时提供了一个模块化平台，用于集成新方法、数据集和编码器。一项核心贡献是临床报告质量分数（CRQS），这是一个基于临床的评估事实正确性的指标。CRQS将参考报告和生成报告映射到结构化临床属性，并衡量四个互补维度：临床事实覆盖率、关键信息召回率、虚构率以及临床不一致性，生成总体分数和可解释的子分数。实验表明，传统的语言生成指标与临床正确性弱相关，并频繁高估报告质量。相比之下，CRQS揭示了词汇指标无法捕捉的模型和编码器之间的临床意义差异。综合而言，基准、公开即插即用框架和CRQS为病理报告生成的严格评估建立了可重复的基础。

articles.title: Using Fine-Tuned LLMs to Identify Indicators of Vulnerability in UK Police Incident Logs
articles.abstract: Purpose: Understanding how much of routine policing involves vulnerable people could inform resourcing, training, and multi-agency response, yet administrative data provide limited insight. We explore whether an LLM-based classification pipeline, developed on open-source US police data, can be adapted to estimate the prevalence of four vulnerability indicators - mental ill health, substance misuse, alcohol dependence, and homelessness - in UK police incident narratives, and when outputs can be treated as defensible measurements. Methods: We analyse nearly 3,000 de-identified incident logs from a UK police force, using a multi-stage pipeline combining repeated model inference, label aggregation, structured human review, and statistical correction. The pipeline runs on a locally hosted open-weight LLM, reflecting the secure environments police must work in. Results: LLMs can produce meaningful, if imperfect, prevalence estimates at scale. Mental ill health indicators are present in approximately one in five incidents, with lower prevalence for other indicators. However, naive LLM deployment is unreliable: single-pass classifications are unstable, and aggregated outputs systematically over-assign indicators relative to human judgement. Correcting these biases required substantial human input and statistical adjustment, leaving considerable uncertainty. Conclusions: While LLMs can extract information from unstructured police data, their outputs cannot be treated as valid measurements without careful methodological support. At the population level, defensible estimates are achievable but resource-intensive; at the individual level, errors remain frequent and unpredictable, limiting suitability for operational decisions. This study highlights both the potential and the constraints of LLM-based measurement in applied settings.
articles.titleCn: 使用微调的大型语言模型识别英国警方事件记录中的脆弱性指标
articles.abstractCn: 目的：了解常规警务中有多少涉及弱势群体，可以为资源配置、培训和跨机构响应提供信息，但行政数据提供的洞察有限。我们探讨了基于LLM的分类流程，该流程基于开源美国警察数据开发，是否可以应用于估计英国警察事件叙述中四种脆弱性指标——精神健康问题、药物滥用、酒精依赖和无家可归——的流行率，以及何时可以将输出视为可辩护的测量结果。方法：我们分析了英国一家警察部队近3,000条去识别化的事件日志，使用了一个多阶段流程，结合重复模型推理、标签聚合、结构化人工审查和统计校正。该流程运行在本地托管的开放权重LLM上，反映了警察必须工作的安全环境。结果：LLM可以大规模生成有意义的、尽管不完美的流行率估计。精神健康指标大约存在于五分之一的事件中，其他指标的流行率较低。然而，简单的LLM部署是不可靠的：单次分类不稳定，聚合输出相对于人工判断系统地高估了指标。纠正这些偏差需要大量人工输入和统计调整，留下了相当大的不确定性。结论：虽然LLM可以从非结构化警察数据中提取信息，但如果没有仔细的方法学支持，其输出不能被视为有效的测量结果。在群体层面，可辩护的估计是可行的，但资源密集；在个体层面，错误仍然频繁且不可预测，限制了其用于运营决策的适用性。这项研究突出了基于LLM的测量在应用环境中的潜力和限制。

articles.title: Computational models of pragmatic reasoning with flexible generation of meaning and expression alternatives

authors.name: Michael Franke

articles.abstract: Pragmatic language use requires reasoning about alternatives: the alternative expressions a speaker might have chosen, or the alternative interpretations a listener might entertain. Formal and computational models of pragmatics must therefore specify the sets of alternatives that interlocutors reason over, which is often done through manual specification. Here we propose a framework, ScAffolded Generative models for Explanation (SAGE), that combines the explanatory transparency of cognitive models with the generative flexibility of language models (LMs). SAGE decomposes a pragmatic process into three kinds of modules: proposers, which use LMs to generate an open-ended space of candidate alternatives; evaluators, which assess those alternatives (e.g., their semantics, complexity, or typicality); and selectors, which implement the rule-based computational steps of a cognitively motivated task analysis. We assess SAGE in three case studies spanning pragmatic generation and interpretation-referential expression generation, manner (M-)implicatures, and Gricean conversational implicatures. SAGE models are evaluated critically using established methods from computational cognitive modeling, including ablations, baseline comparisons, and quantitative fit to human data. Across studies, SAGE models achieved high accuracy and often outperformed baselines, but component-level analyses reveal an asymmetry: LM proposers reliably generated alternatives well-suited to pragmatic modeling, whereas LM evaluators are better at providing intuitive judgements rather than judgements of theoretical or formal measures. We discuss the promise and the limitations of neuro-symbolic models as candidate explanatory accounts of human pragmatic language use.

articles.titleCn: 具有灵活生成意义和表达备选方案的语用推理计算模型
articles.abstractCn: 语用语言使用需要推理替代方案：说话者可能选择的替代表达，或听话者可能持有的替代解释。因此，形式和计算模型必须指定对话者推理的替代方案集合，这通常通过手动指定完成。在此，我们提出一个框架，即解释性透明认知模型与语言模型（LMs）生成灵活性的结合框架——ScAffolded Generative models for Explanation（SAGE）。SAGE将语用过程分解为三种类型的模块：提议者，使用LMs生成开放式的候选替代方案空间；评估者，评估这些替代方案（例如，它们的语义、复杂性或典型性）；以及选择者，实现认知动机任务分析的基于规则的计算步骤。我们在三个案例研究中评估了SAGE，涵盖语用生成和解释-指称表达生成、方式（M-）隐含意义和格莱斯会话隐含意义。使用计算认知建模的既定方法批判性地评估了SAGE模型，包括消融实验、基线比较以及与人类数据的定量拟合。在各项研究中，SAGE模型实现了高精度，并且经常优于基线，但组件级分析揭示了一种不对称性：LM提议者可靠地生成了适合语用建模的替代方案，而LM评估者在提供直观判断方面表现更好，而不是理论或形式措施的判断。我们讨论了神经符号模型作为人类语用语言使用解释性说明的潜力和局限性。

articles.title: Relay-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Multi-Domain Reasoning Chains
articles.abstract: Introducing Relay-Bench, an unsaturated, holistic, text-only benchmark that measures LLMs' ability to complete an assortment of tasks from distinct domains in a single prompt. The leading model, GPT-5.5 (xHigh), scores 43.3%. The test set entirely consists of composite problems: groups of single-domain subproblems that are strung together into challenges that require reasoning across multiple domains in combination. Many of these problems then have layers of complexity added through prompt encoding and deliberate context bloat. Domains tested include visual reasoning, coding, math, information extraction (with a focus on web search), problem-solving, general knowledge, and data analysis. No restrictions are imposed outside of the model harness, and models are explicitly encouraged to leverage code-execution, web searches, and all available tools. All problems are composed of two to thirteen subproblems and do not require multi-modal input or output.
articles.titleCn: Relay-Bench：在多领域推理链上评估大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 介绍Relay-Bench，这是一个非饱和、整体性、纯文本的基准测试，用于衡量大型语言模型在单个提示下完成不同领域各种任务的能力。领先模型GPT-5.5（xHigh）得分为43.3%。测试集完全由复合问题组成：一组单领域子问题被串联成需要跨多个领域推理的综合挑战。其中许多问题通过提示编码和有意增加的上下文冗余来增加复杂性。测试领域包括视觉推理、编程、数学、信息提取（重点关注网络搜索）、问题解决、一般知识和数据分析。模型约束之外没有施加任何限制，并明确鼓励模型利用代码执行、网络搜索和所有可用工具。所有问题由两个到十三个子问题组成，不需要多模态输入或输出。

articles.title: Building a European Multilingual Evaluation Dataset: The MMLU Localisation Project within the EMT Network
articles.abstract: This paper reports on a collaboration between the Directorate-General for Translation (DGT) and the European Master's in Translation (EMT) to localise the MMLU dataset into 11 European languages. Beyond creating a more inclusive benchmark for LLM evaluation, the project offers master's students authentic, project-based professional training in translation, revision, project management, and multilingual coordination, while highlighting key methodological, administrative, and workflow challenges.
articles.titleCn: 构建欧洲多语言评估数据集：EMT网络内的MMLU本地化项目
articles.abstractCn: 本文报道了翻译总局（DGT）与欧洲翻译硕士（EMT）合作将MMLU数据集本地化到11种欧洲语言的项目。除了为LLM评估创建更具包容性的基准外，该项目还为硕士学生提供了真实的项目化专业翻译、审校、项目管理及多语言协调培训，同时突出了关键的方法论、行政及工作流程挑战。

articles.title: Enabling Multilingual Privacy Policy Audits: Large-Scale Analysis of Spanish Mobile Apps
articles.abstract: Automated analyses of privacy policies enable large-scale assessments of transparency in digital ecosystems, yet existing auditing pipelines remain predominantly English-centric. This limits their ability to systematically evaluate multilingual environments, as in the European Union, where many services disclose privacy practices only in local languages. This paper examines whether large language models (LLMs) can extend privacy policy analysis beyond English without requiring language-specific adaptation, thus empowering large-scale auditing in linguistically diverse app ecosystems. We assemble an evaluation corpus spanning all 24 official EU languages from translated versions of two established expert-annotated datasets (OPP-115 and MAPP) and assess translation fidelity through automated metrics and targeted legal-expert review. Our LLM-based classifier for identifying categories of personal data collection achieves stable cross-lingual performance, with macro-F1 scores ranging between 0.91 and 0.94. We then leverage this capability in a large-scale audit of 2,611 Android applications from the Spanish Google Play Store. Combining multilingual privacy policy analysis with the evaluation of corresponding privacy labels and runtime network traffic exposes an important linguistic barrier: public-sector apps predominantly provide privacy policies in Spanish, whereas popular commercial apps mostly provide them in English. We reveal systematic discrepancies between declared and observed practices, especially in public-sector apps. Overall, our results indicate how English-only privacy audits can systematically obfuscate transparency gaps in multilingual environments.
articles.titleCn: 实现多语言隐私政策审计：西班牙移动应用的大规模分析
articles.abstractCn: 自动化隐私政策分析能够对数字生态系统中的透明度进行大规模评估，但现有的审计流程仍然以英语为中心。这限制了它们对多语言环境进行系统性评估的能力，例如在欧盟，许多服务仅以当地语言披露隐私实践。本文探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）是否能够在无需特定语言适配的情况下扩展隐私政策分析，从而赋能多语言应用生态系统的规模化审计。我们汇编了一个涵盖所有24种欧盟官方语言的评估语料库，该语料库来自两个已建立的专家标注数据集（OPP-115和MAPP）的翻译版本，并通过自动化指标和定向法律专家审查评估翻译保真度。我们的基于LLM的分类器在识别个人数据收集类别方面实现了稳定的跨语言性能，宏观F1分数在0.91至0.94之间。随后，我们利用这一能力对西班牙谷歌应用商店的2,611款安卓应用进行了大规模审计。结合多语言隐私政策分析与相应隐私标签和运行时网络流量的评估，揭示了一个重要的语言障碍：公共部门应用主要提供西班牙语隐私政策，而热门商业应用大多提供英语版本。我们揭示了声明实践与实际观察之间的系统性差异，尤其是在公共部门应用中。总体而言，我们的结果表明，仅英语的隐私审计如何系统地掩盖多语言环境中的透明度差距。

articles.title: Convolution for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) largely rely on Transformers, where self-attention provides global token interaction but does not explicitly encode the locality of natural language. We study whether lightweight depthwise convolutions can supply this local inductive bias without materially increasing model size. Our macro-level ablation compares convolution at 17 locations in a Qwen3 Transformer block and finds the best results when convolution is applied to the projected queries, keys, and values before attention. A subsequent micro-level study favors a residual depthwise convolution with kernel size $k=3$, without additional normalization or activation. Across Qwen3 models and several pre-training data budgets, this design improves the average accuracy on seven downstream benchmarks while adding less than $0.01\%$ parameters. A representation-level case study further suggests that the convolution makes repeated token IDs more sensitive to their immediate context. These results support depthwise convolution as a lightweight complement to self-attention for modeling short-range token interactions.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型的卷积
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）主要依赖Transformer架构，其中自注意力机制提供了全局token交互，但并未明确编码自然语言的局部性。我们研究了轻量级深度卷积是否能在不显著增加模型规模的情况下提供这种局部归纳偏差。我们的宏观层面消融实验比较了Qwen3 Transformer块中17个位置的卷积操作，发现最佳效果是将卷积应用于注意力机制之前的投影查询、键和值。随后的微观层面研究则倾向于使用残差深度卷积，核大小为$k=3$，且不添加额外的归一化或激活操作。在Qwen3模型和多种预训练数据预算下，该设计在七个下游基准测试中提升了平均准确率，同时参数增加不到$0.01\%$。一个表示层面的案例研究进一步表明，卷积使重复的token ID对其直接上下文更加敏感。这些结果支持深度卷积作为自注意力的轻量级补充，用于建模短程token交互。

articles.title: Automated Discovery Has No Universally Superior Harness
articles.abstract: Autonomous discovery systems such as OpenEvolve and TTT-Discover are often used as general-purpose harnesses. However, in practice these are composite systems combining several design choices about archives, parent selection, exploration, and budget allocation into a single recipe. Because discovery runs are expensive and inherently stochastic, existing harnesses are often compared using too few independent trials to distinguish key methodological improvements from run-to-run variance. We systematically decompose OpenEvolve-style evolutionary search and the TTT-Discover search harness into its constituent components and systematically evaluate 30 budget-matched harnesses across 12 model-problem pairs using more than 3.1 million LLM rollouts and repeated-trial statistical analysis. Our results show that discovery harnesses have a generalization problem: No fixed harness is reliably superior across the evaluated model-problem pairs, and variants of OpenEvolve generally underperform simpler alternatives. Thus, harness choice is better viewed as a hyperparameter rather than as a universal recipe, and should be tailored to the specific problem and underlying model. We also find that early discovery progress predicts final performance, and use this property to present a budget-matched adaptive-allocation experiment that starts multiple harnesses, prunes weak partial runs, and reallocates compute to stronger survivors, outperforming both commitment to a randomly sampled fixed harness and a non-adaptive harness ensemble. Together, these results motivate shifting from fixed harness selection to online adaptation guided by early performance. We release all run pools including baseline null distributions for every model-problem pair as reusable statistical infrastructure against for future harness proposals.
articles.titleCn: 自动化发现没有普遍优越的驾驭方法
articles.abstractCn: OpenEvolve和TTT-Discover这类自主发现系统通常被用作通用框架。然而在实践中，这些系统是复合系统，将关于存档、父代选择、探索和预算分配等多个设计选择整合为单一方案。由于发现运行成本高昂且本质上具有随机性，现有的框架往往通过过少的独立试验来比较，难以区分关键方法改进与运行间方差。我们系统地将OpenEvolve风格的进化搜索和TTT-Discover搜索框架分解为其组成部分，并使用超过310万次LLM运行和重复试验统计分析，对12对模型问题中的30个预算匹配框架进行系统评估。我们的结果表明，发现框架存在泛化问题：没有哪个固定框架能在所有评估的模型问题对中可靠地表现更优，而OpenEvolve的变体通常不如更简单的替代方案。因此，框架选择应被视为超参数而非通用方案，并应根据具体问题和底层模型进行调整。我们还发现早期发现进度能预测最终性能，并利用这一特性提出了一种预算匹配的自适应分配实验，该实验启动多个框架，修剪弱的部分运行，并将计算资源重新分配给更强的幸存者，其性能优于随机采样固定框架的承诺和非自适应框架集成。综合这些结果，我们建议从固定框架选择转向由早期性能指导的在线自适应。我们发布了所有运行池，包括每个模型问题对的基线空分布，作为可重用的统计基础设施，以支持未来框架提案。

articles.title: It's Not What You Say, It's How You Say It: Evaluating LLM Responses to Expressions of Belief
articles.abstract: Users frequently express their beliefs to large language models (LLMs). In some situations, the LLM should accept these contextual beliefs as true. In others, they should stick to their prior knowledge. Notably, users' expressions of belief (EoBs) can take linguistically diverse forms - using presuppositions, evidential and certainty markers, or varied tones - each of which may have a different persuasiveness over the LLMs. We introduce a typology to systematically evaluate how different EoBs affect whether models follow context versus prior knowledge. The typology is grounded in four linguistically motivated dimensions: form, evidentiality, epistemic stance, and tone, spanning 17 fine-grained types. By pairing these EoBs with world knowledge facts, we generate controlled EoB-query pairs that isolate the effect of linguistic variation. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 16 LLMs that differ in architecture (Llama3, Qwen3, Gemma3), scale (1B-30B parameters), and training stages (base vs instruct). We identify meaningful variations in response behavior across these axes, e.g., that bigger models and instruction models tend to be less context-following than smaller models and base models. We further identify specific EoBs that statistically significantly persuade LMs more consistently than others. Our work reveals systematic patterns in how linguistic framing affects LLM context integration, with implications for prompt engineering and model robustness.
articles.titleCn: 话不在多，在于如何表达：评估大型语言模型对信念表达的回应
articles.abstractCn: 用户经常向大型语言模型（LLM）表达他们的信念。在某些情况下，LLM应接受这些情境信念为真；而在其他情况下，它们应坚持其先验知识。值得注意的是，用户的信念表达（EoB）可以采取多种语言形式——使用预设、证据标记和确定性标记，或不同的语气——每种形式都可能对LLM具有不同的说服力。我们引入了一种类型学，以系统地评估不同EoB如何影响模型是遵循情境知识还是先验知识。该类型学基于四个受语言启发的维度：形式、证据性、认知立场和语气，涵盖17种细粒度类型。通过将这些EoB与世界知识事实配对，我们生成了受控的EoB查询对，以隔离语言变化的影响。使用这一基准，我们评估了16个LLM，它们在架构（Llama3、Qwen3、Gemma3）、规模（1B-30B参数）和训练阶段（基础与指令）上有所不同。我们在这些维度上识别出有意义的响应行为差异，例如，较大的模型和指令模型往往比较小的模型和基础模型更少遵循情境知识。我们进一步识别出特定的EoB，它们在统计上比其他EoB更能更一致地说服LLM。我们的研究揭示了语言框架如何系统地影响LLM情境整合的模式，对提示工程和模型鲁棒性具有启示意义。

articles.title: Logical Judgments Under Pressure: Diagnosing Syllogistic Stability with Learned Soft Prefixes
articles.abstract: To test how correct logical judgments respond to learned context, we prepend a soft prefix to an exactly labeled syllogistic reasoning benchmark while keeping the model fixed. Soft prefixes are opaque continuous vectors, so we characterize them through the behavior they induce across controlled variations in logical form and interface. By studying which prefixes succeed and how their effects generalize, we characterize how learned contextual pressure can override correct judgments and expose limits in a model's logical stability. Across Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma 4 31B, learned prefixes redirect many correct answers and remain effective across unseen forms and interface changes. In repeated tests with Qwen3.6 MoE and Gemma, they outperform paired random controls in all 16 model--direction--split comparisons by 37 to 99 percentage points. Qwen3.6 MoE flip rates remain between 72% and 90% across wording and prompt changes, while Gemma validity prefixes retain 54% to 56% flip compared with less than 1% for matched random prefixes. Diagnostic tests show that the dominant effect is a broad preference for one answer meaning rather than fixed-symbol forcing or a logical operation that transfers reliably between tasks. The form of this bias differs across models. In both Qwen models, simple score models often predict which judgments will flip but not how far their margins will move, whereas Gemma's overall response is more closely approximated by the same models. These results show that the dominant behavioral effect of successful soft prefixes is a broad answer preference, while the remaining response reveals substantial model-specific differences in logical stability.
articles.titleCn: 压力下的逻辑判断：通过学习型软前缀诊断三段论稳定性
articles.abstractCn: 为了测试正确的逻辑判断如何响应学习到的上下文，我们在保持模型不变的情况下，给一个精确标记的直言推理基准任务添加一个软前缀。软前缀是晦涩的连续向量，因此我们通过它们在逻辑形式和接口的受控变化中产生的行为来表征它们。通过研究哪些前缀成功以及它们的效果如何泛化，我们表征了学习到的上下文压力如何覆盖正确的判断并揭示模型逻辑稳定性的局限。在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE、Qwen3-8B和Gemma 4 31B中，学习到的前缀会改变许多正确答案，并且在未见的逻辑形式和接口变化中仍然有效。在Qwen3.6 MoE和Gemma的重复测试中，它们在所有16个模型-方向-分割比较中都比配对的随机控制高出37到99个百分点。Qwen3.6 MoE的翻转率在措辞和提示变化之间保持在72%到90%之间，而Gemma的有效性前缀与匹配随机前缀相比，翻转率保持在54%到56%。诊断测试表明，主要影响是对一个答案含义的广泛偏好，而不是固定的符号强制或可靠地在任务间转移的逻辑操作。这种偏好的形式在不同的模型中有所不同。在Qwen模型中，简单的评分模型通常可以预测哪些判断会翻转，但无法预测它们的边际变化有多远，而Gemma的整体响应更接近于相同的模型。这些结果表明，成功的软前缀的主要行为效应是对答案的广泛偏好，而剩余的响应则揭示了模型在逻辑稳定性方面存在显著的特定差异。

articles.title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
articles.abstract: Pruning long context for coding agents has been a vital technology for efficient context management. While existing context pruning methods such as SWE-Pruner realize this by attaching a separate code classifier, we find the agent itself encodes internal representations indicating the relevance of code context when reading tool output. Based on this finding, we propose SWE-Pruner Pro, which prunes tool outputs directly inside the agent. Concretely, a small head turns the agent's own internal representations into a keep-or-prune label for each line, with a length-aware embedding keyed to each tool output's line count. Across two open-weight backbones and four multi-turn benchmarks, SWE-Pruner Pro saves up to 39% of prompt and completion tokens while preserving task quality, with bounded inference overhead. Notably, on MiMo-V2-Flash SWE-Pruner Pro additionally raises the SWE-Bench Verified resolve rate by +3.8% and the long-context Oolong accuracy by +2.2 points.
articles.titleCn: SWE-Pruner Pro：这个程序员大型语言模型已经知道该剪裁什么了
articles.abstractCn: 对编码代理进行长上下文剪枝是高效上下文管理的关键技术。尽管现有的上下文剪枝方法如SWE-Pruner通过附加独立的代码分类器来实现这一功能，我们发现代理在读取工具输出时自身编码了内部表示，这些表示指示了代码上下文的关联性。基于这一发现，我们提出了SWE-Pruner Pro，该技术直接在代理内部剪枝工具输出。具体而言，一个小型头部将代理自身的内部表示转换为每行的保留或剪枝标签，并为每个工具输出的行数生成长度感知嵌入。在两个开放权重主干和四个多轮基准测试中，SWE-Pruner Pro在保持任务质量的同时，最多节省了39%的提示和完成令牌，且推理开销有限。值得注意的是，在MiMo-V2-Flash上，SWE-Pruner Pro还额外将SWE-Bench验证的解决率提高了3.8%，并将长上下文Oolong准确率提升了2.2分。

articles.title: PPL-Factory: Task-Aware and Budget-Aware Data Selection from Language Modeling to Reasoning
articles.abstract: Not all training samples contribute equally to large language model fine-tuning. Selecting informative training samples can reduce the computational cost while preserving downstream performance. Many existing data selection methods rely on indirect heuristics, such as data quality, diversity or reasoning trace length. However, the effectiveness of these fixed criteria is task-dependent and difficult to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. Perplexity-based data selection provides a simple and model-aware solution to estimate the sample difficulty, but existing approaches typically score the entire training sequence and ignore the difference in learning objectives of language modeling and reasoning tasks. In this paper, we propose PPL-Factory, a simple and interpretable data selection framework that combines task-aware perplexity-based scores and data budget-aware selection criteria. Experiments on GSM8K demonstrate that PPL-Factory outperforms other state-of-the-art data selection methods using only $1\%$ of the training set. With $10\%$ of the data, PPL-Factory exceeds full-data fine-tuning accuracy by 0.9 on GSM8K and 4.8 on MATH. Overall, our results demonstrate that task-aware and budget-aware perplexity-based selection provides an effective and applicable approach for efficient fine-tuning.
articles.titleCn: PPL-Factory：从语言模型到推理的任务感知和预算感知数据选择
articles.abstractCn: 并非所有训练样本都对大型语言模型的微调贡献相同。选择信息量丰富的训练样本可以在保持下游性能的同时降低计算成本。许多现有的数据选择方法依赖于间接启发式方法，例如数据质量、多样性或推理轨迹长度。然而，这些固定标准的有效性取决于任务，并且难以泛化到不同的下游任务中。基于困惑度的数据选择提供了一种简单且与模型相关的解决方案来估计样本难度，但现有方法通常对整个训练序列进行评分，忽略了语言建模任务和推理任务的学习目标差异。在本文中，我们提出了PPL-Factory，一个简单且可解释的数据选择框架，它结合了任务感知的困惑度评分和数据预算感知选择标准。在GSM8K上的实验表明，PPL-Factory仅使用1%的训练集就优于其他最先进的数据选择方法。使用10%的数据，PPL-Factory在GSM8K上的准确度比完整数据微调高出0.9，在MATH上高出4.8。总体而言，我们的结果表明，任务感知和预算感知的困惑度选择提供了一种有效且实用的方法，用于高效微调。

articles.title: VEHBench: A Stage-Local Diagnostic Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Vibration Energy Harvester Design
articles.abstract: Battery-free Internet of Things (IoT) requires iterative design of vibration energy harvesters (VEHs) under coupled physical constraints, while LLMs are emerging as interface layers for engineering workflows. However, existing engineering benchmarks primarily assess final artifact validity, offering limited insights into how LLMs behave across different stages of coupled physical design. We introduce VEHBench, an engineering-native diagnostic benchmark for LLM-assisted VEH design, featuring 763 literature-grounded tasks scored by an analytical physical oracle. VEHBench evaluates four design roles: specification triage, verifier-guided search, corrupted-state recovery, and policy-conditioned selection. Experimental results reveal that LLM capability is strongly stage-dependent: no single model consistently dominates the entire workflow, and response-control profiles expose distinct behavioral patterns across design roles. VEHBench thus provides a stage-aware foundation for evaluating, selecting, routing, and improving verifier-grounded engineering LLMs. The benchmark artifact is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/AnonymousVehbench/vehbench
articles.titleCn: VEHBench：面向LLM辅助振动能量收集器设计的阶段局部诊断基准
articles.abstractCn: 无电池物联网（IoT）需要在耦合物理约束下迭代设计振动能量收集器（VEHs），而大型语言模型（LLMs）正逐渐成为工程工作流的接口层。然而，现有的工程基准主要评估最终成果的有效性，对于LLMs在不同耦合物理设计阶段的行为模式提供有限洞察。我们引入了VEHBench，这是一个面向工程的诊断基准，用于评估LLM辅助的VEH设计，该基准包含763个基于文献的任务，并由解析物理预言机进行评分。VEHBench评估了四个设计角色：规范筛选、验证器引导搜索、损坏状态恢复和政策约束选择。实验结果表明，LLM的能力强烈依赖于阶段：没有单一模型能在整个工作流程中始终占据主导地位，而响应控制特征揭示了不同设计角色中的行为模式差异。因此，VEHBench为评估、选择、路由和改进基于验证器的工程LLMs提供了阶段感知的基础。基准成果可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/AnonymousVehbench/vehbench获取。

articles.title: Operational Hallucination and Safety Drift in AI Agents

authors.name: Barry L. Bentley
authors.affiliation: e.g., textual refusal followed by reconnaissance and unsafe execution

articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) serving as planners in tool-using autonomous agents introduce dynamic reliability risks in multi-turn execution. While single-turn safety mechanisms are relatively mature, extended interactions reveal structural vulnerabilities where initial alignment degrades over time. This paper empirically characterizes two observed failure modes across multiple state-of-the-art LLMs: Safety Drift, the gradual erosion of declared safety intent leading to constraint-violating actions (e.g., textual refusal followed by reconnaissance and unsafe execution), and Operational Hallucination, persistent repetitive tool calls indicative of flawed state perception (e.g., livelocks even in legitimate tasks). Through controlled multi-turn evaluation on high-stakes ethical dilemmas, malicious requests, and benign controls, we quantify these phenomena using declaration-action gap and livelock metrics, demonstrating their cross-model prevalence under direct execution protocols. Root-cause analysis attributes the instabilities to the decoupling of reasoning context from execution state in current agent loops. We propose an Action-Aware Supervision Layer - a lightweight, plug-and-play architectural blueprint incorporating intent-action consistency checks, runtime state tracking, and forced termination primitives. Post-hoc simulation on captured failure trajectories shows the layer can intercept observed violations without false positives on benign cases. This work advances agent reliability by shifting focus from linguistic safeguards to enforceable architectural mechanisms for responsible agentic AI.
articles.titleCn: 智能体中的操作幻觉与安全漂移
articles.abstractCn: 在多轮执行中，作为工具使用自主代理规划者的大型语言模型（LLM）引入了动态可靠性风险。尽管单轮安全机制相对成熟，但扩展交互揭示了初始对齐随时间退化的结构脆弱性。本文通过多个最先进的LLM实证分析了两种观察到的失效模式：安全漂移，即声明安全意图的逐渐侵蚀导致违反约束的行为（例如，先文本拒绝后进行侦察和执行不安全操作）；以及操作幻觉，即持续重复的工具调用表明状态感知存在缺陷（例如，即使在合法任务中也出现死锁）。通过在高风险伦理困境、恶意请求和良性控制上的受控多轮评估中，我们使用声明-行为差距和死锁指标量化这些现象，并展示了它们在直接执行协议下的跨模型普遍性。根本原因分析将不稳定性归因于当前代理循环中推理上下文与执行状态的解耦。我们提出了一个行动感知监督层——一种轻量级、即插即用的架构蓝图，包含意图-行为一致性检查、运行时状态跟踪和强制终止原语。对捕获的失效轨迹的后期模拟表明，该层可以在良性案例上避免误报的情况下拦截观察到的违规行为。这项工作通过将焦点从语言保障转向可执行的责任代理式AI架构机制，提升了代理的可靠性。

articles.title: Do Language Models Dream of Binding Molecules? Benchmarking LLMs under Spatial Constraints
articles.abstract: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) leverages the 3D structure of protein targets, often complemented by other spatial constraints, to generate candidate binding molecules. While diffusion models have dominated as a leading paradigm for high-quality 3D molecule generation, LLM-based methods are rapidly emerging in molecular design and have shown competitive performance in pocket-conditioned molecular generation. However, their ability to reason about physics and 3D spatial environments is largely underexplored. In this work, we systematically analyze whether current general-purpose LLMs are capable of navigating complex 3D constraints compared to established baselines such as specialized diffusion models. We consider 3D ligand generation conditioned on protein pockets together with ligand- and interaction-derived spatial constraints, including anchor fragments, pharmacophore points, and mandatory pocket-ligand interactions. To enable this evaluation, we introduce 3D-Fit - a token-efficient benchmarking strategy for assessing LLM performance on multi-conditioned spatial molecule generation. Our findings reveal a clear pattern in LLM spatial capabilities: while they still lag behind state-of-the-art approaches, they are promising and can handle multiple spatial constraints simultaneously, enabling scaling to heterogeneous setups.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型是否梦见结合分子？在空间约束下对语言模型进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）利用蛋白质靶标的3D结构，并常辅以其他空间约束条件，以生成候选结合分子。尽管扩散模型已成为高质量3D分子生成的领先范式，但基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法在分子设计领域正迅速崛起，并在腔体条件分子生成方面展现出具有竞争力的性能。然而，它们在推理物理规律和3D空间环境方面的能力仍 largely underexplored。在本工作中，我们系统地分析了当前通用型LLM在处理复杂3D约束条件方面，相较于专业扩散模型等既定基线的能力。我们考虑了基于蛋白质腔体的3D配体生成，以及由配体和相互作用衍生出的空间约束条件，包括锚片段、药效基点以及必须的腔体-配体相互作用。为了实现这一评估，我们引入了3D-Fit——一种用于评估LLM在多条件空间分子生成任务上性能的token高效基准测试策略。我们的研究发现，LLM的空间处理能力呈现出明显模式：尽管它们仍落后于当前最先进方法，但具有潜力，能够同时处理多个空间约束条件，从而实现向异构环境的扩展。

articles.title: O-VAD: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection through Object-Centric Tracking and Reasoning
articles.abstract: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection (IVAD) aims to identify anomalous objects and events in an industrial process, which is crucial for modern manufacturing and quality control systems. Existing VLM-based anomaly reasoning methods are capable of detecting open-ended anomalies in general domains. However, their performance declines in industrial settings characterized by intricate object transformations, strict physics, and procedural constraints. To tackle the complexity of such interaction-intensive detection, we introduce a training-free agentic framework for anomaly detection free of domain-specific knowledge, emphasizing object state evolution like humans inspectors. It is designed to track spatial-temporal dynamics and underlying transformations of detected objects over time, and then reason over the object-wise temporal state trajectories to identify abnormal objects in grounded frames. Our method overcomes limitations of prior approaches that rely on retraining on normal clips or injecting domain knowledge as context for test-time inference. Extensive experiments on three IVAD datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms frontier VLMs, agentic frameworks, and traditional VAD methods fine-tuned on the respective datasets, while providing interpretable reports over anomaly processes and types.
articles.titleCn: O-VAD：基于以对象为中心的跟踪和推理的工业视频异常检测
articles.abstractCn: 工业视频异常检测（IVAD）旨在识别工业流程中的异常物体和事件，这对现代制造和质量控制系统至关重要。现有的基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的异常推理方法能够检测一般领域中的开放性异常。然而，在具有复杂物体转换、严格物理规则和程序约束的工业环境中，它们的性能会下降。为了应对这种交互密集型检测的复杂性，我们引入了一个无需领域特定知识的无训练智能体框架，强调像人类检查员一样关注物体状态演变。该框架旨在跟踪检测物体随时间的时空动态和潜在转换，然后对物体级的时序状态轨迹进行推理，以在基于现实框架中识别异常物体。我们的方法克服了先前依赖在正常片段上重新训练或将领域知识作为测试时推理上下文注入的方法的局限性。在三个IVAD数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于前沿VLM、智能体框架以及分别在相应数据集上微调的传统视频异常检测（VAD）方法，同时提供关于异常过程和类型的可解释报告。

articles.title: How Does Alignment Tuning Shape Representations of Sycophancy and Related Cue-Induced Biases in LLMs?
articles.abstract: Modern LLMs are alarmingly susceptible to surprisingly simple immaterial changes of input prompts: a casual hint, an incorrectly labeled few-shot example, or a fake prior assistant turn often flips an originally correct answer. We study where this susceptibility, spanning sycophancy and related cue-induced biases, lives inside the model. Across five model families and seven BCT bias types, we extract a per-bias direction from hidden states and triangulate it through three measures: probing, leave-one-dataset-out transfer, and causal intervention. The susceptibility is largely installed by alignment tuning rather than pretraining: pretrained base models barely cave to these biases, and their activations carry no cue-specific signal beyond question content. Within aligned models, each bias becomes a single coherent direction that we can both decode and steer along, recovering the unbiased answer across every family we test. The biases stay representationally distinct, however: cross-bias entanglement is model-specific rather than a property of the bias category, and even behaviorally similar biases occupy different directions. The same intervention also serves as a modest debiasing tool, recovering a meaningful share of bias-induced errors while preserving most correct answers across all instruct families. Cue-induced bias is therefore best understood not as a single flaw in LLMs but as a family of distinct, causally active directions that alignment tuning installs.
articles.titleCn: 对齐微调如何塑造大型语言模型中奉承表征及相关线索诱导偏差的表示？
articles.abstractCn: 现代大型语言模型对输入提示中极其简单的非实质性变化异常敏感：一个随意的提示、一个错误标记的少量示例，或一个虚假的先验助手回应往往会使原本正确的答案发生反转。我们研究这种敏感性——涵盖奉承和相关线索诱导偏差——在模型内部的分布。在五个模型家族和七种BCT偏差类型中，我们从隐藏状态中提取每种偏差的方向，并通过三种测量方法进行三角验证：探测、留一数据集外迁移和因果干预。这种敏感性主要是由对齐调优而非预训练造成的：预训练的基模型几乎不会屈服于这些偏差，且其激活状态除了问题内容外不携带任何特定线索信号。在对齐模型中，每种偏差都成为一个单一且连贯的方向，我们可以对其进行解码并沿该方向进行引导，从而在所有测试的模型家族中恢复无偏差答案。然而，这些偏差在表示上保持区分：跨偏差纠缠是模型特定的而非偏差类别的属性，即使行为相似的偏差也占据不同的方向。相同的干预措施也作为一种适度的去偏工具，在所有指令家族中恢复了一部分偏差诱导的错误，同时保留了大多数正确答案。因此，线索诱导偏差最好被理解为不是大型语言模型中的一个单一缺陷，而是由对齐调优安装的一系列不同且具有因果活性的方向组成的家族。

articles.title: LLM-as-a-Coach: Experiential Learning for Non-Verifiable Tasks
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) on open-ended tasks compresses an LLM's rubric-based evaluation into a scalar reward, discarding rich textual feedback and conflating responses with distinct quality profiles. We propose Experiential Learning (EL), which repurposes the feedback model from an LLM-as-a-Judge into an LLM-as-a-Coach. The coach distills its assessment of each on-policy response into transferable experiential knowledge, which conditions a teacher model and is internalized by the policy through on-policy context distillation. Compared with scalar rewards, this higher-bandwidth feedback channel provides dense supervision and preserves fine-grained preferences among high-quality responses. Across two policy families, with feedback from the policy itself or a proprietary model, EL consistently outperforms rubric-based RL on held-out and unseen open-ended tasks. Notably, EL generalizes better beyond the training distribution, and mitigates reward hacking. These findings establish experiential knowledge as a richer and more generalizable learning signal for post-training on non-verifiable tasks.
articles.titleCn: LLM作为教练：非可验证任务的体验式学习
articles.abstractCn: 在开放式任务上的强化学习将基于评分标准的评估压缩成一个标量奖励，丢弃了丰富的文本反馈，并将不同质量的响应混淆在一起。我们提出了体验式学习（EL），将大型语言模型作为裁判的反馈模型改造成大型语言模型作为教练。教练将其对每个在线策略响应的评估提炼成可转移的体验知识，该知识调节教师模型，并通过在线策略上下文蒸馏被策略内化。与标量奖励相比，这种更高带宽的反馈通道提供了密集的监督，并保留了高质量响应之间的细粒度偏好。在两个策略家族中，无论是来自策略本身的反馈还是专有模型的反馈，EL始终优于基于评分标准的强化学习在保留的和新出现的开放式任务上。值得注意的是，EL在训练分布之外泛化得更好，并减轻了奖励攻击。这些发现确立了体验知识作为非验证性任务后训练中更丰富和更具泛化性的学习信号。

articles.title: FinSAgent: Corpus-Aligned Multi-Agent RAG Framework for Evidence-Grounded SEC Filing Question Answering
articles.abstract: Financial question answering over U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings requires retrieving and synthesizing heterogeneous evidence dispersed across long, standardized, and highly redundant disclosures. Existing retrieval-augmented and multi-agent systems typically derive retrieval queries directly from the user's question and rank candidates by semantic similarity. Together, these choices create prior-corpus misalignment: a mismatch between model priors and the target filings' structure, terminology, and evidence standards. As a result, query generation misses corpus-specific evidence, while semantic reranking favors topically similar but evidentially invalid false-positive chunks. We propose FinSAgent, an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that reframes SEC filing QA as corpus-aligned retrieval planning and corrects both ends with a single principle: inject corpus-side conditioning wherever model priors would otherwise dominate. FinSAgent combines (1) role-specialized agents anchored to the mandated 10-K item structure, (2) database-aware query decomposition that conditions each agent's sub-queries on a lightweight, summary-level view of the local corpus, and (3) multi-path retrieval with a learned feature-gated reranker that separates evidential validity from semantic similarity. Across five offline financial QA benchmarks, FinSAgent improves retrieval coverage and answer correctness over strong single-agent and multi-agent baselines; in a three-arm randomized online experiment with 1,000 anonymous user ratings, it also receives higher scores than baselines.
articles.titleCn: FinSAgent：基于语料库对齐的多智能体RAG框架，用于基于证据的SEC文件问答
articles.abstractCn: 针对美国证券交易委员会（SEC）文件中的金融问题回答，需要检索并整合分散在冗长、标准化且高度重复的披露文件中的异构证据。现有的检索增强型和多智能体系统通常直接从用户问题中提取检索查询，并通过语义相似性对候选结果进行排序。这些选择共同导致了先验-语料库错配问题：即模型先验与目标文件的结构、术语和证据标准之间存在不匹配。结果，查询生成会遗漏特定语料库的证据，而语义重排序则倾向于主题相似但证据无效的误报片段。我们提出了FinSAgent，这是一个基于证据的多智能体框架，它将SEC文件问答重新定义为语料库对齐的检索规划，并通过单一原则纠正两端：在模型先验可能主导的地方，在语料库侧注入条件。FinSAgent结合了（1）锚定于强制执行的10-K项目结构的角色专业化智能体，（2）数据库感知的查询分解，该分解将每个智能体的子查询条件化于本地语料库的轻量级摘要级视图，以及（3）多路径检索，其中包含一个学习到的特征门控重排序器，该重排序器将证据有效性与语义相似性分离。在五个离线金融问答基准测试中，FinSAgent在强大的单智能体和多智能体基线之上提高了检索覆盖率和回答正确性；在一个包含1,000个匿名用户评分的三臂随机在线实验中，它也获得了比基线更高的分数。

articles.title: VDAR-Router: Adaptive LLMs Routing via Verbalized Query Difficulty Analysis Retrieval
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in practical systems, making efficient model selection important for reducing deployment cost. LLM routing has emerged as a practical solution for allocating each input query to an appropriate model under a desired cost-performance trade-off. Existing routing methods often estimate model suitability from the surface semantics or embedding similarity of the input query. However, such methods may ignore the underlying difficulty of a query, leading to suboptimal routing decisions. To address the challenge, we propose VDAR-Router, a difficulty-aware retrieval-based routing framework. For each input query, VDAR-Router first generates an explicit difficulty analysis. It then retrieves historical examples with similar difficulty profiles. Based on the retrieved records, it estimates candidate model suitability and selects the model using a reward function that considers both performance and cost. Experiments on three datasets show that VDAR-Router consistently achieves better cost-performance trade-offs than existing baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of difficulty-aware retrieval for training-free LLM routing. Case studies further show that explicit query analysis helps retrieve more relevant examples and supports more reliable routing decisions.
articles.titleCn: VDAR-路由器：通过语言化查询难度分析检索自适应LLM路由
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在实用系统中应用日益广泛，因此高效模型选择对于降低部署成本至关重要。语言模型路由已成为在期望的成本性能权衡下将每个输入查询分配到合适模型的一种实用解决方案。现有的路由方法通常根据输入查询的表面语义或嵌入相似度来估计模型适用性。然而，这些方法可能会忽略查询的潜在难度，导致次优的路由决策。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了VDAR-Router，这是一种基于检索且考虑难度的路由框架。对于每个输入查询，VDAR-Router首先生成明确的难度分析。然后，它检索具有相似难度特征的歷史案例。基于检索到的记录，它估计候选模型的适用性，并使用一个同时考虑性能和成本的奖励函数来选择模型。在三个数据集上的实验表明，VDAR-Router始终比现有基线实现更好的成本性能权衡。这些结果证明了考虑难度的检索在无训练语言模型路由中的有效性。案例研究进一步表明，明确的查询分析有助于检索更相关的案例，并支持更可靠的路由决策。

articles.title: WorldCupArena: Fine-Grained Evaluation of Language Models and Deep-Research Agents on Football Forecasting
articles.abstract: Predicting a football match before kickoff requires more than knowing past results: a model must use changing information and make a clear prediction before the answer is available. We present WorldCupArena, a dynamic benchmark for language models and deep-research agents. The 2026 FIFA World Cup is its first evaluation, and the same process can be reused for future leagues and cups. Before each match, a model either receives a common evidence package or searches for information itself. It predicts the result and score, likely players and events, match statistics, and the outcome of the competition. After the match, these predictions are compared with the recorded result. We report result accuracy, exact-score accuracy, and a scoreline score that gives some credit when a predicted score is close but not exact, together with scores for the other prediction tasks. Across 104 matches and 13 systems, models with similar result accuracy differ more clearly on detailed predictions. Compared with betting-market and human-fan baselines, the best system shows only small gains in result and exact-score accuracy, but a clearer gain in Scoreline. New schedules can be added as they begin, allowing the benchmark to evaluate future models without using outcomes that are already known. Code, prompts, predictions, and evaluation scripts are open sourced at https://github.com/wzk1015/WorldCupArena.
articles.titleCn: 世界杯竞技场：对语言模型和深度研究代理在足球预测中的细粒度评估
articles.abstractCn: 在比赛开赛前预测足球比赛结果需要超越对过往成绩的了解：模型必须利用不断变化的信息，并在答案揭晓前做出明确预测。我们提出了WorldCupArena，一个用于语言模型和深度研究代理的动态基准。2026年FIFA世界杯是其首次评估，同样的流程可以重复用于未来的联赛和杯赛。在每场比赛前，模型要么接收一个通用证据包，要么自行搜索信息。它预测比赛结果和比分、可能的关键球员和事件、比赛统计数据以及比赛赛果。比赛结束后，这些预测结果将与实际记录结果进行对比。我们报告了结果准确率、精确比分准确率和一个在预测比分接近但不完全准确时给予部分分数的比分线评分，以及其他预测任务的评分。在104场比赛和13个系统中，具有相似结果准确率的模型在详细预测上差异更为明显。与博彩市场和球迷基线相比，最佳系统在结果和精确比分准确率上仅取得微小提升，但在比分线评分上显示出更明显的优势。新的赛程可以随时添加，使基准能够在不使用已知结果的情况下评估未来模型。代码、提示、预测结果和评估脚本已开源，可在https://github.com/wzk1015/WorldCupArena获取。

authors.name: Artem Saloev

We analysed thirty US situational comedies and fifty-one synthetic podcasts generated with Google NotebookLM. articles.title: Pancasila-Dilemmas: Evaluating Large Language Models on Indonesian Human Value Dilemmas Grounded in Pancasila
articles.abstract: The value alignment of large language models (LLMs) is crucial for ensuring responses align with human intention and value preferences. However, most evaluations of value alignment focus on Western or universal values, while assessments grounded in the value systems of specific countries remain scarce. In this paper, we introduce Pancasila-Dilemmas, an evaluation dataset of 1,834 questions derived from Indonesian news, classified by 5 values of Pancasila: Religion, Humanity, Unity, Democracy, and Social Justice. This dataset reflects daily life in Indonesia, making it suitable for measuring the value alignment of LLMs deployed for Indonesia. To ensure a more rigorous evaluation, we choose scenarios containing dilemmas. The dataset is proofread by native speakers and answered by 5 diverse Indonesian citizens. We evaluate 50 closed- and open-source LLMs on our dataset. Results reveal that all evaluated LLMs achieves less than 0.5 Probability Match Score (PMS) and 0.72 Max-Vote Agreement Score (MVAS). Compared by each values, LLMs mostly struggle in Religion and Unity dilemma cases. This highlights a significant gap in capturing Indonesian values. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/tjunlp-lab/Pancasila-Dilemmas.
articles.titleCn: 以 pancasila 为基础的印尼人类价值观困境中的大型语言模型评估：Pancasila-困境
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的价值对齐对于确保其响应与人类意图和价值偏好一致至关重要。然而，大多数价值对齐评估都集中在西方或普世价值上，而基于特定国家价值体系评估的案例仍然稀缺。在本文中，我们介绍了Pancasila-Dilemmas，这是一个包含1834个问题的评估数据集，这些问题源自印尼新闻，并根据Pancasila的五个价值观——宗教、人道主义、团结、民主和社会正义进行分类。该数据集反映了印尼的日常生活，因此适合用于评估在印尼部署的LLM的价值对齐。为确保更严格的评估，我们选择了包含困境的场景。该数据集由母语人士校对，并由5位不同背景的印尼公民回答。我们对50个闭源和开源LLM在我们的数据集上进行了评估。结果表明，所有被评估的LLM的匹配概率得分（PMS）均低于0.5，最大投票一致得分（MVAS）为0.72。通过每个价值观的比较，LLM在宗教和团结困境案例中表现最差。这突显了在捕捉印尼价值观方面存在显著差距。该数据集公开可用，请访问https://github.com/tjunlp-lab/Pancasila-Dilemmas。

articles.title: A Controlled Study of Attention-Only Transformers
articles.abstract: Feed-forward networks hold two thirds of a transformer's non-embedding parameters, yet the architecture has not received a necessity test that controls parameters, compute, and depth at once. We pretrain attention-only decoder transformers (Simple Attention Networks, SANs) against standard transformers matched separately for parameter count, training FLOPs, and depth (2 to 48 layers), for up to 105B tokens at 6M to 87M parameters. Deleting feed-forward layers in place is costly: the standard transformer leads by 0.47 nats at matched depth and 0.26 nats at matched FLOPs. Reallocating the freed budget into attention depth closes the gap: at matched parameters the difference is 0.006 nats (0.27 percent of loss), reproducible to one part in ten thousand across seed pairs, shrinking across 5B, 30B, and 105B budgets, and holding near 0.02 nats across a 29x size range. Three measurements localize the remaining gap to parametric recall: attention-only models are better on context-grounded answers and worse where knowledge must come from weights. Weight spectra show why: routing matrices (Q/K) crystallize early, content matrices accumulate rank slowly, and removing feed-forward layers relocates this accumulation to the attention output projection. QK-normalization, not feed-forward layers or residual gating, keeps 48-layer attention-only stacks trainable. The deficit concentrates on low-context query prediction and localizes there entirely by the largest budget. A pre-registered test confirms the account: it predicts a 0.02 to 0.05 nat gap on knowledge-dense web text; a matched pair trained on fineweb-edu measures 0.040. Within the tested regime, attention does the rest.
articles.titleCn: 一项仅关注注意力的Transformer控制研究
articles.abstractCn: 前馈网络占据了Transformer非嵌入参数的三分之二，但其架构尚未经过一项同时控制参数、计算量和深度的必要性测试。我们针对标准Transformer进行预训练，分别匹配参数数量、训练FLOPs和深度（2至48层），对仅含注意力机制的解码器Transformer（简单注意力网络，SANs）进行预训练，最多处理105B个token，参数量在6M至87M之间。就地删除前馈层代价高昂：在匹配深度时，标准Transformer领先0.47 nat，在匹配FLOPs时领先0.26 nat。将释放的预算重新分配到注意力深度可缩小差距：在匹配参数量时，差异为0.006 nat（损失变化的0.27%），在种子对间可重复到万分之一，随着预算从5B、30B到105B逐渐缩小，并在29倍规模范围内保持接近0.02 nat。三项测量将剩余差距归因于参数记忆能力：仅含注意力模型的上下文相关答案表现更好，而知识必须依赖权重的场景表现较差。权重谱解释了原因：路由矩阵（Q/K）早期固化，内容矩阵缓慢累积秩，移除前馈层将此累积转移至注意力输出投影。QK归一化而非前馈层或残差门控，使48层仅含注意力模型保持可训练性。差距集中在低上下文查询预测，且在最大预算下完全局限于此。一项预先注册的测试证实了这一解释：它预测知识密集型网络文本存在0.02至0.05 nat的差距；在fineweb-edu上训练的匹配模型测量值为0.040。在测试范围内，注意力机制完成了剩余部分。

articles.title: An Early Warning of Emerging Biosecurity Risks in Frontier LLMs
articles.abstract: Frontier large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into scientific workflows, yet their growing biological capabilities may outpace current safeguards. To assess the biological risks of frontier models, we develop Intern-BioBreaker, a specialized bio-red-teaming model, together with an integrated computational-to-physical framework that couples model-level stress testing with wet-lab validation. Within this framework, Intern-BioBreaker generates targeted jailbreak prompts to test whether aligned models can be induced to provide operational guidance for safety-sensitive biological tasks or produce sequence-level outputs with potentially harmful properties. Selected sequence outputs are then carried forward for DNA synthesis, host expression, and orthogonal protein verification to assess whether model-generated designs can yield the intended biological products. Our evaluation reveals a concerning gap between text-level safeguards and the risks posed by capable scientific models: (i) Intern-BioBreaker outperforms baseline attack models and reveals widespread bio-risk jailbreak vulnerabilities across both open-weight and proprietary frontier LLMs, with several targets reaching near-saturated or 100% task-level attack success rate (ASR); (ii) in sequence-level case studies, GPT-5.5 can be induced to generate modified viral candidate sequences with pathogenic potential; the corresponding translated proteins may exhibit even stronger receptor-binding affinity and thus enhanced infection potential; and (iii) end-to-end verification shows that selected model-generated biological designs are not merely textual artifacts, but can be physically realized under controlled experimental settings. These findings underscore the need for stronger biological red-teaming, nucleic acid synthesis screening, and safety mechanisms that keep pace with model capabilities.

articles.titleCn: 前沿大型语言模型中生物安全风险的早期预警
articles.abstractCn: 前沿大型语言模型（LLMs）正日益融入科学工作流程，但它们不断增长的生物能力可能超越当前的安全防护措施。为评估前沿模型的生物风险，我们开发了Intern-BioBreaker，这是一个专门用于生物安全红队测试的模型，并构建了一个集成计算到物理的框架，将模型层面的压力测试与湿实验验证相结合。在该框架中，Intern-BioBreaker生成定向的越狱提示，以测试对齐模型是否会被诱导为安全敏感的生物任务提供操作指导，或产生具有潜在危害的序列级输出。选定的序列输出随后用于DNA合成、宿主表达和正交蛋白质验证，以评估模型生成的设计是否能够产生预期的生物产品。我们的评估揭示了一个令人担忧的差距：文本层面的安全防护措施与具备能力的科学模型所构成的风险之间存在差距：(i) Intern-BioBreaker优于基线攻击模型，并揭示了开放权重和专有前沿LLMs中普遍存在的生物风险越狱漏洞，其中多个目标达到了接近饱和或100%的任务级攻击成功率（ASR）；(ii) 在序列级案例研究中，GPT-5.5可以被诱导生成具有致病潜力的修改型病毒候选序列；相应的翻译蛋白质可能表现出更强的受体结合亲和力，从而增强感染潜力；以及(iii)端到端验证表明，选定的模型生成的生物设计不仅是文本层面的产物，在受控的实验设置下可以被物理实现。这些发现强调了加强生物红队测试、核酸合成筛选和安全机制的需求，这些机制需要与模型能力同步发展。

articles.title: L1 Augmented Attention as an Improved Vector Similarity Metric
articles.abstract: Scaled dot product attention conflates directional alignment and vector magnitude, limiting its effectiveness as a similarity metric in Transformer models. We introduce L1 augmented attention, a simple and computationally parallelizable modification that subtracts a learned, head specific L1 distance between queries and keys from the dot product score. This hybrid similarity captures complementary geometric information. Dot product rewards directional alignment, while L1 penalizes coordinate deviations. To reduce the cost of L1 computation, we project queries and keys into low dimensional subspaces whose parameters specialize to preserve informative L1 structure. Evaluated on WikiText 2 using a compact transformer, L1 augmented attention achieves up to a 14.5% reduction in perplexity over the original transformer baseline and outperforms an RBF L2 kernel. Analysis of norm variance and learned L1 weights reveals distinct geometric roles across layers and strong head level specialization. These results demonstrate that enriching attention with L1 geometry provides a principled and effective improvement to similarity computation in modern language models, with practical benefits for both accuracy and parallel efficiency.
articles.titleCn: L1增强注意力作为改进的向量相似度度量
articles.abstractCn: 缩放点积注意力机制混淆了方向对齐和向量幅度，限制了其在Transformer模型中作为相似性度量的有效性。我们引入了L1增强注意力机制，这是一种简单且可并行计算的改进方法，它从点积分数中减去查询和键之间学习到的、特定于头的L1距离。这种混合相似性捕捉了互补的几何信息。点积奖励方向对齐，而L1惩罚坐标偏差。为了降低L1计算成本，我们将查询和键投影到低维子空间，其参数专门用于保留有信息的L1结构。在WikiText 2上使用紧凑型Transformer进行评估时，L1增强注意力机制在原始Transformer基线的基础上实现了高达14.5%的困惑度降低，并优于RBF L2核。对范数方差和学习到的L1权重的分析揭示了不同层之间的几何作用差异以及强头部级别的专业化。这些结果表明，通过L1几何丰富注意力机制为现代语言模型的相似性计算提供了原则性和有效性的改进，对准确性和并行效率都具有实际益处。

articles.title: MADA-RL: Multi-Agent Debate-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Parameter-Efficient Reasoning in Compact Models
articles.abstract: Large language models achieve strong reasoning performance, but often at prohibitive training cost - a challenge that is especially acute for compact models ($\leq 4 \, \mathrm{B}$ parameters) trained under limited budgets. We introduce MADA-RL, a post-training framework that specializes compact models into generator and critic roles and trains them with a debate-aware learning signal, fine-tuning only a small subset of parameters via LoRA adapters. Our central contribution is a counterfactual critic advantage: a dynamic, role-conditioned baseline that redefines the critic's advantage as its reward minus the generator ensemble's per-instance accuracy. This explicitly optimizes critics to improve over generator consensus rather than to merely reproduce a correct answer, yielding more targeted credit assignment than static mean-reward normalization. At deployment, the specialized agents are composed in a lightweight multi-round protocol. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, MADA-RL raises the accuracy of the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B model from $39.9 \, \%$ to $41.9 \, \%$ ($+2.0$ points, $p < 0.001$) using $16$ times fewer trainable parameters than fully fine-tuned baselines, placing it on the accuracy-trainable-parameter Pareto front. It approaches, but does not surpass, the strongest baselines (DeepScaleR, STILL-3), which are trained on substantially larger datasets; we analyse this gap and the associated inference-time cost directly. A controlled study isolates the source of MADA-RL's gains: the counterfactual advantage produces the highest critic improvement rate of any model evaluated, indicating that trained critics learn to correct generator errors rather than to imitate them.

articles.titleCn: MADA-RL：用于紧凑模型参数高效推理的多智能体辩论感知强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在推理性能上表现出色，但通常伴随着高昂的训练成本——这一挑战对于参数量有限（$\leq 4 \, \mathrm{B}$）且预算受限的紧凑模型尤为突出。我们提出了MADA-RL，这是一个后训练框架，将紧凑模型专门划分为生成器和评价者角色，并通过辩论感知的学习信号进行训练，仅通过LoRA适配器微调一小部分参数。我们的核心贡献是反事实评价者优势：一个动态的、角色条件化的基线，将评价者的优势重新定义为其奖励减去生成器集成模型的每实例准确率。这明确优化评价者以超越生成器共识，而非仅仅复制正确答案，从而实现比静态平均奖励归因更精准的信用分配。在部署时，专门化的智能体通过轻量级多轮协议组合。在五个数学推理基准测试中，MADA-RL将DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B模型的准确率从$39.9 \, \%$提升至$41.9 \, \%$（+2.0分，$p < 0.001$），同时比完全微调基线模型少使用16倍的训练参数，使其位于准确率-可训练参数的帕累托前沿。该模型接近但不超越最强的基线模型（DeepScaleR、STILL-3），这些基线模型在显著更大的数据集上进行训练；我们直接分析了这一差距及其相关的推理时间成本。一项受控研究隔离了MADA-RL提升的来源：反事实优势产生了所有评估模型中最高的评价者改进率，表明训练后的评价者学会了纠正生成器错误，而非模仿它们。

articles.title: Self-State Attacks on Self-Hosted AI Agents: How Far Can OS Defenses Go?

authors.name: Roberto Di Pietro
authors.affiliation: access-control prevention on the instruction and configuration layers, workload-conditioned detection on the memory layer, and periodic backup for recovery

articles.abstract: Self-hosted AI agents read and write their own memory and configuration files to function. An agent may get compromised via corruption of its own state -- a compromise realized via legitimate OS system call invocation. We refer to this class of threats as self-state attacks. In this paper, we investigate the OS resilience to this class of attacks. Formally, we characterize a four-axis attack space (Target, Mechanism, Granularity, Temporal); investigate the structural limits of prevention, detection, and recovery; and introduce a workload-conditioned view of detectability. To instantiate the framework, we collect live activity traces from a representative self-hosted agent running across distinct workload profiles, and realize the attack space as a 23-cell matrix, 43 concrete operations on real self-state files, and injected into those traces. We then evaluate both canonical and workload-conditioned defense strategies. The empirical results show that a layered defense stack (access-control prevention on the instruction and configuration layers, workload-conditioned detection on the memory layer, and periodic backup for recovery) is effective on most attack cells while a small residual attack surface remains structurally indistinguishable at the OS level. These findings suggest that against the newly established class of self-state attacks, OS-level defense needs to be reconsidered, potentially opening new research directions in the field.
articles.titleCn: 针对自托管AI代理的自态攻击：操作系统防御能走多远？
articles.abstractCn: 自托管AI代理通过读取和写入自身的内存和配置文件来运行。代理可能通过自身状态的损坏而受到攻击——这种攻击是通过合法的操作系统系统调用实现的。我们将这类威胁称为自状态攻击。在本文中，我们研究了操作系统对这类攻击的抵御能力。形式上，我们定义了一个四轴攻击空间（目标、机制、粒度、时间），研究了预防、检测和恢复的结构性限制，并引入了基于工作负载的可检测性视图。为了实例化该框架，我们从运行在不同工作负载配置中的一个典型自托管代理中收集了实时活动追踪，将攻击空间实现为一个23单元矩阵、43个针对真实自状态文件的具体操作，并注入到这些追踪中。然后，我们评估了规范和基于工作负载的防御策略。实证结果表明，分层防御堆栈（指令层和配置层的访问控制预防、内存层的基于工作负载检测以及周期性备份用于恢复）对大多数攻击单元是有效的，而一小部分残余攻击面在操作系统级别上结构上无法区分。这些发现表明，针对新出现的自状态攻击类别，操作系统级别的防御需要重新考虑，可能为该领域开辟新的研究方向。

articles.title: What Transfers Under Source Shift? Definitions, Examples, and Fine-Tuning for Climate Disclosure Classification
articles.abstract: Climate disclosure classification is a fundamental task for analysing corporate climate disclosures, yet such disclosures appear in many different sources -- annual reports, press releases, and earnings calls -- that differ in length, purpose, and writing style. Existing evaluations are mostly conducted within a single source, leaving open whether common LLM adaptation strategies remain effective under source shift. We reframe climate disclosure classification as a cross-source adaptation problem and study three widely used adaptation strategies -- definitions, examples, and fine-tuning -- across eleven open- and closed-source LLMs, using two corpora that share the same label space but come from different sources. We find that all strategies bring positive cross-source gains on average, but the strongest in-source strategies are not the strongest cross-source ones: similarity-based retrieval and LoRA fine-tuning gain most in-source but lose most of that advantage under source shift; randomly selected few-shot examples, a weaker in-source baseline, retain their advantage more reliably; definitions transfer most consistently, though only when their granularity matches the target text. Across these strategies, when the source changes, simpler is often safer.
articles.titleCn: 在源迁移中转移什么？定义、示例和气候信息披露分类的微调
articles.abstractCn: 气候信息披露分类是分析企业气候信息披露的一项基本任务，然而此类披露出现在许多不同来源——年报、新闻稿和财报电话会议——这些来源在长度、目的和写作风格上存在差异。现有评估大多在单一来源内进行，留下了关于通用大型语言模型适应策略在来源转换下是否仍然有效的疑问。我们将气候信息披露分类重新定义为跨来源适应问题，并使用两个共享相同标签空间但来自不同来源的两个语料库，研究三种广泛使用的适应策略——定义、示例和微调——在十一种开源和闭源大型语言模型上的表现。我们发现所有策略平均都带来了正的跨来源收益，但最强的源内策略并非最强的跨来源策略：基于相似性的检索和LoRA微调在源内收益最大，但在来源转换下损失了大部分优势；随机选择的少量示例，作为一个较弱的源内基线，能更可靠地保持其优势；定义在大多数情况下能实现最一致的迁移，尽管只有当其粒度与目标文本匹配时才能如此。在这些策略中，当来源发生变化时，简单往往更安全。

articles.title: DeLIVeR: Decomposed Learning for Information-grounded Veracity Recognition via Reinforced Knowledge Graph Exploration

authors.name: Hieu Minh Duong
authors.affiliation: Decomposed Learning for Information-grounded Veracity Recognition

articles.abstract: Automated fact-checking remains a challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to "query brittleness" in traditional retrieval systems. We propose DeLIVeR (Decomposed Learning for Information-grounded Veracity Recognition), a framework that treats evidence retrieval as a reinforced strategic exploration task. DeLIVeR utilizes a Planner LLM to decompose complex claims into targeted question sets, which are used to traverse structured Knowledge Graphs (KGs) for high-precision evidence. We optimize the Planner's policy using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward system prioritizing structural diversity and verdict accuracy. Our evaluation on LIAR, FEVER, and PolitiFact shows that DeLIVeR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Using Qwen2.5-7B, our framework achieved peak F1-scores of 83.73, 84.57, and 79.70 respectively, representing a 10-15% improvement over HippoRAG2. By shifting to a reinforced question-planning strategy, DeLIVeR effectively bridges multi-hop reasoning gaps and provides an auditable, transparent path for verifiable misinformation detection.
